name: Manganji Urara
source: [url=/c150926]Yukihisa[/url]'s childhood friend and current employer. She owns a popular [i]doujin[/i] circle called "URARARARA," earning money from her sales. Even though she is playful and likes teasing others, deep down she prioritizes her friends more than anything.
